notes.title: After Steam Next Fest Update!
notes.content:
Hello, Humans!👽



First of all, thanks a lot to everyone who engaged with us and our demo during Steam Next Fest, we gathered a lot of feedback and were able to work towards some updates to make sure the experience is closer to what you expect, still there's a lot for us to work on, but we are getting there!



Your opinion helps us shape the game.

You can leave your feedback on our Discord server or in the Community Hub



Try the demo, share your thoughts, and don’t forget to wishlist Who Are You!? 🛸



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/118ba2cba325911ce18d32126da1d669b443b56b.png"]

Fixed steps sound effects

Fixed general ambience sounds

Fixed missing collisions

Fixed translations on different languages

Fixed level streaming in certain areas

Fixed UI on Asian Languages

Fixed interaction prompt

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/6dc9b13bdd62b3da1df2ef5ff7cb86cf27e653de.png"]

Added small video on intro scene.

New small interactions added added to the game

New sounds added to the earthquake scene

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/ca468064aa58786aa3cb86fec75b59fb4b292923.png"]

Key scene on intro level improved.

notes.title: Demo Live & Major Update for Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Hello, Humans!👽



The demo is now available as part of Steam Next Fest, and we’re excited to finally share it with you!
This update features a new scenario, deeper lore, and more aliens.
Below, you’ll find a detailed devlog describing all the new content we've added.



Your opinion helps us shape the game.

You can leave your feedback on our Discord server or in the Community Hub



Try the demo, share your thoughts, and don’t forget to wishlist Who Are You!? 🛸



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/118ba2cba325911ce18d32126da1d669b443b56b.png"]

Fixed an issue where the game would freeze after clicking a save slot.

Resolved multiple localization problems across different languages.

Objects now properly carry over between maps.

The radio can now be turned off.

Fixed several LOD issues for more consistent visual performance.

Applied texture fixes to various assets.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/6dc9b13bdd62b3da1df2ef5ff7cb86cf27e653de.png"]

Fully reworked the "Cabin" map and added it to the demo.

Added a brand new courtyard area to the intro map.

Introduced new interactions in the intro map.

New languages added:

German

Italian

French

Japanese

Korean

Simplified Chinese

Traditional Chinese

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/ca468064aa58786aa3cb86fec75b59fb4b292923.png"]

Optimized performance in the intro map.

Replaced footstep sounds with more immersive versions.

Improved game design and flow in the "Cabin" map.

Added new ambient sounds to enhance the atmosphere in the "Cabin" area.

Updated images in picture frames and polaroids for better visual storytelling.

notes.title: 🔧Devlog 1.0
notes.content:
Hello, Humans! 👽

We’ve just released an update to enhance your experience with the new demo. Below is a list of all the fixes and new features.

We hope you had a wonderful Christmas and wish you a Happy New Year!

See you soon, Human.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/118ba2cba325911ce18d32126da1d669b443b56b.png

 Fixed an issue where the disclaimer did not translate into the selected language.
 Improved earthquake effects for enhanced realism and performance.
 Enabled physics on several objects that were previously static.
 Fixed a bug preventing the main door key from being picked up.
 Corrected collisions on the stairs.
 Adjusted the LODs (Level of Detail) for various objects.
 Fixed an issue where static noise from the TV was audible during the final cutscene.
 Corrected significant grammar errors across all supported languages.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/6dc9b13bdd62b3da1df2ef5ff7cb86cf27e653de.png

 Added a "Brightness" option for improved accessibility and customization.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/df69b4220bfbcdfc89e384cbb881ee5c45ff7ca7.png

notes.title: NEW DEMO OUT!
notes.content:
Hello, Humans! 👽

The new demo is finally out! After almost a year of hard work and growth, the game has undergone many changes. But now, we’re proud to offer a more polished and professional experience, something that feels more nostalgic, depressing, and eerie.

The demo explores the introductory level, this is a deep experience with an immersive narrative, so pay attention to your surroundings.

The demo playtime is around 20 minutes.

See you soon, Humans.

notes.title: News & Updates
notes.content:
Hello Humans!👽

Yes, it's been a long time since our last update. But also, it's been a long time since we took a break! Since we released The Amanda Roswell Project, we have been working on Who Are You!? relentlessly.

In April, we started remaking the demo all. over. again. What you are going to see in the next months is nothing compared to what you played. We can't set a date for the release of the new demo, but I can guarantee you it's going to be worth the wait.

When we started with Who Are You!? it was only for the fun of it, testing our teamwork in a game jam. But now we have a clear vision and goals, we are more experienced and know better what we want with this story.

So bear with us a little longer; we can't wait to tell the world this twisted story we created.

In other news, Who Are You!? just has been featured on The Horror Game Awards Showcase! Here you can click the link to watch our trailer, and have a sneak peak of some changes we made so far.

See you soon, Humans.

notes.title: Team's Life Update & IndieDB Competition 🎮
notes.content:
Hello, Humans! 👽
We just wanted to give you a quick update on the team – we're still alive but very busy! As this incredible year comes to an end, there are a lot of personal and professional things that we need to take care of.

On another note, we're reaching out to ask for your help! For those who may not be familiar, IndieDB is a platform that supports indie developers in showcasing their work. Currently, there's an ongoing competition to select the indie game of the year, and it would mean a lot to us if you could vote for 'Who Are You!?' Just click on the link below and proceed to click the 'VOTE NOW' button. There are only two days and a few hours left to vote‼️

INDIEDB - WHO ARE YOU!?

That's it! We want to express our gratitude to all the people who support us and keep motivating us to do better things. We'll see you soon, human.

notes.title: 🔧Update for Fixes & Improvements🔧
notes.content:
Hello, Humans! 👽
We made an update to fix some things in the demo, so here's a short devlog! But first, here's a reminder: any AI voices found in the game are just placeholders while we work setting up all the voice acting.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/af04f0bef47726df23827f46a3a59088378bcd99.gif

 The bug in the maze where you had to die once is now fixed.
 Small lightining fixes.
 AI works better during the maze level.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44705174/dd056ca1d76448cedddbd1c13b446e60ba85e7a1.gif

 Ray's voice fixed 100%, now all his lines are made by the voice actor.
 Intro house modified removing assets that were not needed.
 Amy's body can be seen now on the intro.


Bear in mind that this is a work in process, we'll keep adding more patches on the demo so you can see it's full potential.

‼️More voice actors joining, so keep an eye on more exciting news‼️
